Image Caption Adder

Add a clean caption bar to the top or bottom of any photo — with font size, colors and padding controls.

The caption bar becomes part of the exported image. Everything runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose a photo.
  2. Type your caption.
  3. Pick top or bottom placement, font size and colors.
  4. Click "Download image" to save the PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the caption burned into the image?

Yes — the bar becomes part of the image itself, so it shows up everywhere the image is shared.

How tall is the caption bar?

The bar height grows automatically with the font size and padding you choose.

Is my photo uploaded?

No — your photo stays on your device; the caption is drawn on a canvas in your browser.
